task_label: Debug routine semantic reuse date guard for calendar plus weather
acceptance_criteria: Only the allowlisted routine runner and focused routine tests may change.
A saved calendar-plus-weather routine must not semantically match when the requested weather time reference differs from the stored routine arguments.
The existing city guard must keep working.
Natural saved-routine reuse for the same date/time intent must keep working.
Run only the focused pytest command before returning.

Return concise JSON-compatible output with status, root_cause, changed_files, command_results, summary, and blockers.
